about_the_game:
This game offers a light roguelike experience. Every time you level up, you can purchase an upgrade item. Use your own build to crush all the enemies that appear!

The main game content provided by this game

Multiple mechs to choose from

    []

    Each mech has different performance, handling, and initial abilities.

    [/]

Multiple types of weapons

    []

    There are various types of weapons such as self-propelled guns, main guns, and secondary guns. Each weapon provides a different experience.

    [/][]

    The self-propelled gun has a high firing rate and is good at dealing damage to shields, but the direct damage to enemies is relatively low.

    [/][]

    The bullets of the self-propelled gun cannot collide with the bullets of the enemies.

    [/][]

    The main gun has great power, but the ammunition quantity is limited. The bullets of the main gun can collide with the bullets of the enemies. With a specific build, you can even confront the enemies head-on and suppress them with direct firepower.

    [/][]

    The secondary gun has great power and strong bullet-clearing ability, but the cooldown time is also quite long.

    [/]

Multiple types of friendly units

    []

    Drones: They stay by your side and protect you at all times, but they are relatively fragile. Through upgrades, they can provide you with better protection.

    [/][]

    Frigates: They move quickly and can chase after enemies and attack them. Through upgrades, they can become excellent wingmen.

    [/][]

    Battleships: They have great power, but their mobility is poor. Through upgrades, they can turn into firepower fortresses.

    [/][]

    Choose the appropriate ship hulls and form your own fleet!

    [/]

Collision damage

    []

    Be careful not to run into the enemies!

    [/][]

    Be careful not to hit the meteorites!

    [/][]

    The enemies also need to watch out for the meteorites. ~~

    [/][]

    When the enemy's firepower is too strong, maybe hide behind the meteorites?

    [/]

Massive projectiles

    []

    As you upgrade, your firepower will become stronger and stronger. A huge number of bullets will gush out from your gun barrels. Have a great time shooting!

    [/]

short_description: Nebula Strike is a 2.5D top-down twin-stick shooter game with a space theme. The main feature of this game is its exhilarating and thrilling gaming experience.
supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Polish, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Portugal, Arabic
